name: Mercadians
description: Evasive, aloof rulers of the city; nobles are hedonistic and commoners are selfish.

description_citations.text: "Mercadian Masques". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard was the Mercadian soldiers' hero; they stumbled when he left.
timeline.quote: Gerrard was the Mercadian soldiers' greatest hero; they followed him blindly.

citation.text: Cowardice (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Cho-Arrim attack and steal the ship, and Mercadia City soldiers arrive to arrest the crew.
timeline.quote: The ship is attacked by the Cho-Arrim

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Mercadian magistrate offers Gerrard soldiers and Cateran mercenaries to recover the Weatherlight in exchange for the ship's return and safe passage.
timeline.quote: The Mercadian magistrate unexpectedly offers Gerrard an unusual deal.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Takara brokers a new deal: the crew will repair the Weatherlight for the magistrate in exchange for freedom; Sisay, Hanna and Orim head to Saprazzo for a needed artifact.
timeline.quote: Takara brokers a new deal with the magistrate

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
